title: Technology and cyber due diligence note

paragraphs.text: The platform is hosted on a major public cloud and holds ISO 27001 certification.
The company does not hold a SOC 2 Type II report, which several enterprise prospects have requested.
About 38% of the codebase runs on an unsupported framework version. We estimate 18 to 24 months and EUR 3m to EUR 4m to remediate; the latest penetration test found no critical issues.
